---
title: "MFA Challenges"
description: "Second-factor challenges issued at sign-in in a reporting period."
---

The number of second-factor challenges CanadaLogin issued at sign-in over a
selected reporting period: one per code sent, and one per passkey prompt that
reached an outcome.

This metric measures second-factor volume. It counts challenges, not people, and
not outcomes: an SMS code that is sent and never entered is still a challenge.
For the challenges that reached an outcome, see [Second-factor
Attempts](second-factor-attempts.qmd).

It covers the factors the public can sign in with: `sms_otp`, `voice_otp`, and
`fido2` (passkeys). `email_otp` is left out because it only checks an email
address at sign-up (see [Sign-up Email Verification
Rate](sign-up-email-verification-rate.qmd)), and `kq`, `totp`, `qr`, and
`ibm_verify_push` are internal factors. For every factor the platform records,
see [All MFA Activity by Factor](mfa-activity-by-factor.qmd).

## Calculation

Restrict to the sign-in factors and sum `count` over the selected reporting
period. The OTP factors (`sms_otp`, `voice_otp`) record both a `sent` event and a
subsequent `success`/`failure` event for the same challenge; to avoid
double-counting, only the `sent` row is used for these. `fido2` does not generate
a `sent` event, so its `success`/`failure` rows are used instead.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Example queries"}

::: {.panel-tabset}

## SQL

```sql
SELECT
    SUM(count) AS mfa_challenges
FROM ibm_verify_events_transformed.events_mfa_activity
-- set the reporting window; see the timespans note in cookbook/notes.qmd
WHERE CAST(from_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-05-28'
  -- the factors the public can sign in with; email_otp is a sign-up check
  AND mfa_type IN ('sms_otp', 'voice_otp', 'fido2')
  -- OTP types record both a "sent" event and a "success"/"failure" event for
  -- the same challenge. Counting all three would double-count them. fido2
  -- has no "sent" event and is counted through its outcome rows instead.
  AND (
    result = 'sent'
    OR (result IN ('success', 'failure') AND mfa_type = 'fido2')
  );
```

## R

```r
tbl(con, in_schema("ibm_verify_events_transformed", "events_mfa_activity")) |>
  # set the reporting window; see the timespans note in cookbook/notes.qmd
  filter(
    as.Date(from_date) >= as.Date("2026-01-01"),
    as.Date(from_date) <= as.Date("2026-05-28"),
    # the factors the public can sign in with; email_otp is a sign-up check
    mfa_type %in% c("sms_otp", "voice_otp", "fido2"),
    # OTP types record both a "sent" and a "success"/"failure" event per
    # challenge; use only "sent" for these. fido2 has no "sent" event.
    result == "sent" |
      (result %in% c("success", "failure") & mfa_type == "fido2")
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mfa_challenges = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

:::

:::

## Interpretation notes

A challenge is not an attempt. Bot traffic that requests SMS codes it cannot
read raises challenges without raising attempts, so a jump in challenges with
no matching jump in [Second-factor Attempts](second-factor-attempts.qmd) is a
sign of automated traffic, not of more people signing in. Passkey (`fido2`)
activity appears only from the 2026-07-06 rollout onward.

## Alternative names

- MFA authentications
- second-factor challenges
- total MFA challenges
- MFA volume
